allReviewedPassages.rawText:
RED 1: the same isolated environment and `bash tests/super-auto/test-scripts.sh`, before helper changes, produced `20 failure(s)`.   got:      2

allReviewedPassages.rawText: A rejection uses disposition `rejected` with the same supported judgment, basis and nonempty evidence; verification is optional for rejection. A source record's payload is the exact complete extraction object, not a key-only reconstruction. For final reviews, keys retain the full original first finding line; roast keys use the producer's before-em-dash convention. Source/section/position refs remain authoritative independently of the legacy printed key.

allReviewedPassages.interpretation: Empty keys cannot establish clean acceptance; unavailable Node/manual fallback and output status describe helper boundary.
allReviewedPassages.rawText: Exit 0: validated projection. Exit 3: retained projection plus evidence/record gaps. Exit 2: invalid CLI or unavailable run.md, no projection established. Exit 4: Node unavailable, no projection established. JSON includes gaps; key mode emits only deduplicated outstanding-deferred keys on stdout and `FINDING_GAP:` diagnostics on stderr. An empty key stream alone cannot mean acceptance is clean. Neither jq nor external packages are needed for this projection; the legacy round mode keeps its existing jq/manual fallback. Without Node, stderr `NODE_UNAVAILABLE:` directs manual conservative projection while retaining evidence.

allReviewedPassages.rawText: Optional supplementary input is `{version:1,records:[{type:"finding-link",refs,basis},{type:"finding-disposition",ref,disposition,judgment,basis,evidence,verification?}]}`. This is a local consumer seam, not a proposed external roast ledger contract. Only references to retained local occurrences are accepted. Absent/malformed/unknown/incomplete inputs report gaps; silence/dissolved/success-only records do not resolve. Valid attributed explicit supported records can supplement the same projection; owning agents must judge semantic support before writing or adapting them. External source/routing replacement is refused. Any external record worth retaining durably should be recorded in local approvals after that judgment.
